name: One Shot Prompting
description: Generate a complete sidecar feature module from a single prompt. No approval gates, no back-and-forth. Claude makes decisions, states assumptions, and ships production-ready code in one response. Perfect for event-driven projects, when you'd rather regenerate than negotiate.
longDescription:
Ships **15 skills**, **15 agents**, **30 commands** and **4 hooks**.

- **Skills** (15): `caveman` (Token compression mode (mattpocock-inspired)), `curator` (Discovers external agents, skills, and MCP servers that could improve the one-shot-prompting pipeline, then adds them to the…), `docs-drift` (Detect codebase changes and auto-generate documentation updates), `execute-plan` (Execute implementation plans task by task), `grill-me` (Intensive questioning (mattpocock-inspired)), `handoff` (Conversation-to-runbook (mattpocock-inspired)), `multi-stage-workflow` (Multi-stage workflow orchestrator implementing Search → Analyze → Generate pattern), `one-shot-generate` (End-to-end agentic one-shot), and 7 more
- **Agents** (15): `architect` (Domain architect for one-shot-prompting feature generation), `critic` (Final integration check), `docs-author` (Watches for code drift and proposes documentation updates), `doubter` (Fresh-context adversarial reviewer), `extractor` (Specialist agent for **ambiguous prose extraction** — only invoked when the deterministic extractor (`extract_domain_model.py`) returns confidence < 0.55…), `implementer` (Writes the production code for ONE file (router, model, schema, or service) given the architect's spec.json), `mcp-service-integrator` (Discovers and integrates external MCP (Model Context Protocol) services into the curator skill), `memory-propagator` (Propagate cross-project learnings into curriculum and memory systems), and 7 more
- **Commands** (30): `adr` (Create or list Architecture Decision Records (MADR format)), `architecture` (Produce a lightweight architecture blueprint (services, events, file structure, open questions) before generating code), `autonomy` (Manage your plugin autonomy level (operator → collaborator → consultant → approver → observer)), `browser-test` (Drive a real Chrome instance via the chrome-devtools MCP server to test frontend features end-to-end), `budget` (Manage the monthly token budget (set, check usage, preflight a generation)), `check-consistency` (Scan the project for cross-module inconsistencies (mixed serializers / loggers / error handling) and propose a shared library), `context` (Generate a CLAUDE.md skeleton from a project's detected stack + tooling), `curate` (Discover external agents, skills, or MCP servers that could improve the plugin's capabilities for the current task), and 22 more
- **Hooks** (4): `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `SessionStart`, `Stop`

Installs with `claude plugin install one-shot-prompting@claude-community` from `usmanmughaltaleemabad/One-Shot-Plugin`.
